title: NativQA Framework: Enabling LLMs with Native, Local, and Everyday Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing culturally and regionally aligned question-answer datasets using location-specific seed queries to benchmark LLM understanding of diverse cultural elements and local everyday knowledge.

Collecting and validating QA pairs across 7 diverse languages (including low-resource languages) to mitigate the predominance of high-resource language training data and evaluate LLMs' ability to interact naturally in native languages.
Generating region-specific queries and QA datasets across 39 distinct locations in 24 countries to measure and improve the representation of underrepresented regional contexts in LLMs.
